derivation:
exact (algebraMap_isIntegral_iff.mpr inferInstance).isLocalHom
    (Subtype.val_injective.comp (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_injective ℤ_[q] Kw (PadicAlgCl q) (algebraMap ℤ_[q] (PadicAlgCl q)).injective))
explanation: Mathlib proves that an integral ring homomorphism is local when it is injective (lines 606–618). Here the algebra map into the integral closure is integral, and its injectivity follows from the subtype embedding and the scalar-tower embedding into the Padic algebraic closure. The theorem’s current proof instead uses the norm and the ring equivalence with `Rw`.
